decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The London Borough of Hounslow as the Local Planning Authority hereby certifies that on 23 May 2007, erection of a single storey rear and side extension and rear roof extension with roof lights to front of house, as shown on Unnumbered existing and proposed drawings, received 23 May 2007, was lawful within the meaning of Section 191 and 192 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 for the following reason:
Following the proposed extensions consisting of the erection of a single storey rear and side extension and rear roof extension with roof lights to front of house, the resulting building would fall within the provisions of Schedule 2, Part 1,Class A, Class B and class C, of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) Order 1995.
Condition : 2 - Informatives:
1.	The proposed roof extension must not be higher than any part of the existing ridge of the roof. The original ridgeline and ridge capping of the house should be maintained.

2.	The roof lights hereby permitted shall be flush with the existing plane of the roof.

3.	If any others works are commenced before the substantial completion of the hereby-permitted works (00917/6/LAW2), these works will cease to be lawful and would require full planning permission.
description: Certificate of lawfulness for the erection of a single storey rear and side extension and rear roof extension with roof lights to front of house.
